scripts.build: node scripts/images.mjs && npm run build:web && npm run build:single
scripts.build:web: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist dist-ssr && node scripts/compat.mjs dist
scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && vite build --mode single --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr-single && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist-single dist-ssr-single && node scripts/compat.mjs dist-single/index.html && node scripts/size.mjs dist-single/index.html
scripts.build:release: node scripts/check-config.mjs && cross-env SITE_RELEASE=1 npm run build
